context: Shadowheart has come to the House of Grief where a hooded woman — later revealed to be Viconia — is waiting and eventually invites Shadowheart to speak with her down in the Shar Grotto. An Inquirer of Grief is conducting a “Mapping of the Heart” ritual that offers to unburden those who sit on the stone bench; the player steps aside so Shadowheart can take the ritual. The lines shown are from that mapping sequence, in which the Inquirer probes Shadowheart’s reasons for being there. Off-screen, Viconia has been shadowing the meeting in disguise and may be testing or questioning Shadowheart’s psyche before offering a private, potentially consequential conversation in the Grotto.
